name: 39819 · Bainbridge, GA
findings: ZIP 39819 (Bainbridge) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39819 (Bainbridge) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 39819 (Bainbridge) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).
